candidates.formal_type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k],
  Iff (IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k)
    (∀ (p : Polynomial.{u_1} k),
      Ne.{1} (Polynomial.degree.{u_1} p) 0 → Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun x => Polynomial.IsRoot.{u_1} p x)

source_text: A field is algebraically closed exactly when every nonconstant polynomial over it has a root.
